coverage.reason: States that replacement is permitted under an order with board approval, but omits initial shareholder approval of the structure and prospectus disclosure.
Says the principal adviser oversees and remains fully responsible for sub-advisers.
Does not mention that an increase in the aggregate advisory fee rate still needs shareholder approval.
Says shareholders receive an information statement generally within 90 days.

local_error: “or Rule 15a-5, where applicable” — the supplied evidence says the proposed Rule 15a-5 was withdrawn in 2009, so this implies a rule-based route that the evidence does not support.
rationale: Covers board-approved replacement under an order and the adviser’s continuing oversight and responsibility. It omits required initial approval and disclosure details and the fee-increase vote; the unsupported Rule 15a-5 claim is a material local error, capping the grade at partial.
